scope: source-backed pinout, supply-limit, CSI-2 pin-limit, D-PHY/C-PHY mode, device-model and package audit; not land-pattern, GMSL channel or CSI-2 signal-integrity qualification

source.document: MAX96793 CSI-2 to GMSL3/2 Serializer data sheet
source.retrieval_note: analog.com was unreachable; this hash identifies the LCSC mirror file and is not verified against the analog.com file
source.verification: pin numbers transcribed from the Pin Descriptions table and visually checked against the rendered p.24 Pin Configuration (top view)

locators.lane_configurations: p.59, Lane Configurations and Data Rates
locators.csi2_receiver_dc_characteristics: pp.11-12, Electrical Characteristics: D-PHY HS/LP and C-PHY HS/LP receiver

package.description: 32-pin 5 mm x 5 mm TQFN-SW (side-wettable), exposed pad

footprint.kicad_reference: generic KiCad QFN-32 5x5 mm, 0.5 mm pitch, EP 3.1 mm (descr cites Microchip 8008S); chosen because the Maxim-derived TQFN-32 variants are not importable

name_notes.MFP1_CFG0/MFP2_CFG1/X1_OSC: data-sheet names MFP1/CFG0, MFP2/CFG1, X1/OSC with '/' replaced by '_'

supplies.note: decoupling node, no operating range modeled
signal pins; modeled as absolute_min/absolute_max on the CSI-2 device pads (D-PHY and C-PHY), no operating range

connection_policy_basis.optional: D0-D3/CKP/CKN rows: 'leave open if unused' (pp.24-25; for CKP/CKN on the C-PHY D0C/D1A function); VREF: 'leave open if not used' (p.28); X1/OSC open in RoR mode, X2 open in RoR or oscillator mode (p.28)
connection_policy_basis.required: EP is the device ground and must connect to the ground plane (p.27); XRES 402 Ohm to ground and mandatory CAP_VDD decoupling (Table 3, pp.30-31); CFG0/CFG1 dividers latched at power-up, every Table 11/12 row needs at least one resistor (p.61)
connection_policy_basis.normal: MFP0 and MFP3-MFP10 (no leave-open note in the MFP section), SIOP/SION (SION AC-terminated in coax mode), PWDNB

device_model.pad_mapping: one device pad per package pin with the pin's name, plus the six C-PHY trio pads D0A/D0B/D0C/D1A/D1B/D1C named after their data-sheet C-PHY functions; no internal pad connections implied
device_model.differential_pairs_locator: pp.24-25 Pin Descriptions: CSI-2 Data Lane 0-3 and Clock Lane Noninverted/Inverted Input
device_model.csi2_pin_voltage_basis: p.10 Absolute Maximum Ratings: 'D_P/N, CKP/N -0.3V to +1.35V'; given per pin, so applied as absolute_min/absolute_max to all 10 D-PHY pads and all 6 C-PHY pads
device_model.csi2_pin_operating_basis: not given: the CSI-2 receiver tables (pp.11-12) give thresholds and common-mode ranges only; '-0.05V to 1.35V' is the D-PHY LP receiver ILEAK test condition, not a pin operating range
device_model.phy_selection: p.59 Lane Configurations and Data Rates: 'The port can be configured to use either D-PHY v1.2 or C-PHY v1.0'; D-PHY is the state after power-up ((*) markers, pp.24-25)

PHY.locator: p.59 (D-PHY or C-PHY port); pp.24-25 (*) D-PHY state after power-up

device_model.cphy_alternates_locator: pp.24-25 Pin Descriptions, pins 25-30: 'CSI-2 C-PHY Data Lane 0/1, A/B/C Input'; bonded as '<D-PHY pad>@PHY=DPHY,<C-PHY pad>@PHY=CPHY'
device_model.dphy_only_pins_basis: pp.24-25 list only the lane-2/3 function for pins 19-20 and 23-24, and p.59/p.40 give the C-PHY port one or two lane/trios; bonded only with PHY=DPHY, so with PHY=CPHY these pins have no modeled function

unresolved.detail: The data sheet states no function for D2P/D2N/D3P/D3N (pins 19-20, 23-24) with the port in C-PHY mode. They are bonded only with PHY=DPHY, so with PHY=CPHY they are unmodeled (UNMODELED_PIN if connected); 'leave open if unused' still applies.

No operating pin-voltage range is given for the CSI-2 inputs, so only the -0.3 V to +1.35 V absolute maximum is modeled. ERC evaluates it only for CSI-2 pins on nets with a declared supply; signal nets are not voltage-checked.
CopperScript has no trio signal-group kind, so the C-PHY trios D0A/D0B/D0C and D1A/D1B/D1C are modeled as individual pads; ERC does not report a partially connected trio.

Orderable T3255Y uses outline 21-100156 / land pattern 90-100067, which were not obtainable. The EP size is unresolved among the KiCad 21-0140 variants 2.1 mm (T3255-6), 3.1 mm (T3255-3, chosen provisionally) and 3.4 mm (T3255-9); lead lands, paste apertures and side-wettable flank lands remain unverified.
Source hash is of the LCSC mirror copy; the analog.com file was not retrieved.
EP must reach the ground plane through an array of vias; via count/pattern is not specified in the data sheet.
Generic QFN-32 land pattern substitutes for ADI 90-100067; verify lead-land length/width, EP size and side-wettable requirements before fabrication.
